founder_remuneration.notes: Chairman & Founder (staff-001) is unremunerated: staff compensation is 0, so personal income is not payroll. Income is drawn from this holding company as asset-management fees and shareholder distributions — never from the Cook Islands trust, which would undermine the separation that justifies the jurisdiction. A salary belongs in staff/members.json only if a holding company actually employs him. draw_policy_pct caps the draw at 40% of distributable income (Don-Pierre Treasury & Credit); the 60/40 split divides any draw between family office funding and the founder's offshore bucket.

portfolio.name: Don-Pierre Family Office
portfolio.notes: Family office that manages the assets and investments of the Don-Pierre Family.

portfolio.name: Don-Pierre HQ WWA Software
portfolio.notes: Mvita HQ is a family office application that allows the Mvita Family Trust to manage its assets and investments.

portfolio.name: Don-Pierre Vault
portfolio.notes: Live Don-Pierre Vault annual costs — Give gifts, annualized roster tier rates (x members per pay tier; per-person budgets are not read), and legacy heir support from non-placeholder plans only, from vault inventory. Not an asset sleeve (NAV stays $0); spend flows through annual allocations.

portfolio.name: Don-Pierre RealEstate Holding
portfolio.notes: Live Real Estate Fund NAV — sum of all estates in inventory. Annual Budget is the combined carrying cost of all properties (tax, HOA, insurance & ops; no mortgage), computed from estates annualExpenses — not hardcoded.

portfolio.name: Don-Pierre Automotive Holding
portfolio.notes: Live Automotive Fund NAV — sum of ground fleet vehicles. Annual automotive operations expense is calculated automatically as 5% of live automotive fleet value (not hardcoded).

portfolio.name: Don-Pierre Aviation Co.
portfolio.notes: Live Aviation Fund NAV — aircraft and rotorcraft. Annual aviation operations expense is calculated automatically as 10% of live aviation fleet value (not hardcoded).

portfolio.name: Don-Pierre Marine Co.
portfolio.notes: Live Marine Fund NAV — yachts and vessels. Annual yacht operations expense is calculated automatically as 10% of live marine fleet value (not hardcoded).

portfolio.name: Don-Pierre Collections Holding
portfolio.notes: Live Collections Fund NAV — sum of all collection item values across the estate inventory. No annual operating cost is applied to this sleeve.

entities.name: Don-Pierre Equity
entities.notes: Control-oriented private equity: DRC infrastructure, public transit, civil EPC, specialty semiconductor manufacturing, industrials, hospitality, security, and UAE industrial operations. Urban mobility + civil construction are paired as concession operator and preferred builder. Marks use operating EV with project-finance leverage where applicable; debt service is tracked separately from EBITDA.

portfolio.name: University of Kinshasa
portfolio.notes: Private acquisition of a leading Central African university (~$250M EV) focused on engineering, technology, medicine, and business. Built out as a massive integrated campus that also hosts a full tertiary teaching hospital on site — clinical care, medical education, and research under one roof. Revenue mix: tuition (~70%), executive education, research grants, hospital services, and consulting. EBITDA margin ~15% is typical for private tertiary education after scholarships. Acts as the talent pipeline for Congo AI, WtE, telecom, and mining-services operations. Campus includes the School of Renewable Energy, Center for African Technology Innovation, and the on-campus teaching hospital (integrates with Mvita HealthTech for telemedicine).

portfolio.name: DRC Agricultural Operations
portfolio.notes: Commercial agribusiness on 50,000 ha (cassava, maize, rice, palm) with expansion path to 150,000 ha. Enterprise value ~$4,200/ha — aggressive but plausible for irrigated commercial estates with offtake. Revenue ~$1,040/ha; EBITDA ~20% after inputs and labor (40% was unrealistic for row/plantation agri). Linked to Cold Chain processing and WtE ash/nutrient loops where feasible.

portfolio.name: DRC Telecom Infrastructure
portfolio.notes: Wholesale fiber, tower, and backhaul platform covering Kinshasa, Lubumbashi, Goma, and 9 other cities (~1,200 sites / 2,700 km fiber). Towerco/fiber EBITDA margins of ~40% are realistic for infrastructure wholesale (not retail mobile). EV ~$400M ≈ 5.4× revenue. Critical for Congo AI, Fintech mobile-money rails, and Protective Services command connectivity. Long-term MSA/tower-share with MNOs.

portfolio.name: Don-Pierre WtE Power Plant
portfolio.notes: 30 MW waste-to-energy plant (~$6M/MW all-in — in the global WtE band of $4–8M/MW). Converts ~1,000 t/day MSW under a PPA with SNEL at $0.215/kWh × ~8,000 hours × 30 MW ≈ $51.6M revenue (previously marked far above the PPA math). Project finance ~40/60 equity/debt. EBITDA ~35% before debt service is realistic for contracted generation after O&M. Valuation ~$195M ≈ 3.8× revenue / ~1.1× construction.

portfolio.name: Kinshasa Logistics & Inland Dry Port
portfolio.notes: Inland dry port / multimodal hub on the Congo River corridor: bonded warehousing, container yard, and last-mile distribution. EV ~3.6× revenue with ~25% EBITDA — typical for African logistics platforms with captive cargo from agri, cement, and medical supply chains. Cargo tracking via DRC Telecom; cold-chain handoff to Food Processing; rail interchange with Congo Freightway Rail.

portfolio.name: Congo Freightway Rail
portfolio.location: Kinshasa–Matadi Corridor / Bas-Congo, Democratic Republic of Congo
portfolio.notes: 30-year freight concession: ~180 km Kinshasa–Matadi corridor rehab + dry-port spur (~$1.9M/km all-in — typical African rehab band, not greenfield mountain mainline). Hauls ~3.9 Mtpa minerals concentrate, cement, agri bulk, and containers at ~$11/t average yield ≈ $43M revenue. EBITDA ~30% before debt service is normal for freight rail after heavy track O&M. EV ~$300M ≈ 0.86× construction / 7× revenue. Captive cargo from Critical Minerals, Cement, Agri, and Cold Chain; interchange at Kinshasa Logistics dry port; ROW fiber with DRC Telecom; corridor security via Protective Services. Distinct from Kinshasa Public Transport (passenger metro/bus).

portfolio.name: Kinshasa Public Transport
portfolio.notes: Exclusive 35-year Kinshasa multimodal passenger concession — city buses, BRT, and metro/light-rail Phase 1 — structured as the sole formal public-transport franchise for covered corridors (monopoly ops under concession, not informal taxi competition). ~900 buses + 32 km BRT operating; ~12 km metro/LRT Phase 1 in build (civil via DRC Infrastructure Co.). Mix: farebox (~$27M), availability payments (~$24M), ads/ancillary (~$6M). EBITDA ~18% is realistic for African formal transit with labor-heavy bus ops. EV ~$200M marks fleet, depots, systems, and franchise — not the full metro civil book (that sits in construction WIP/EPC). Fleet OS for bus telematics; Congo AI for ridership/dispatch; Protective Services for stations.

portfolio.name: DRC Infrastructure Co.
portfolio.location: Kinshasa / National, Democratic Republic of Congo
portfolio.notes: Integrated civil EPC platform with preferred/exclusive delivery rights on Kinshasa Public Transport (metro tunnels, stations, BRT lanes, depots) plus captive work across Congo Freightway Rail, Water, Telecom civil, WtE, hospital, and Dubai park fit-outs. Peak transit-build years support ~$183M revenue; ~11% EBITDA is a normal heavy-civil margin after materials and subcontractors (not software multiples). Backlog ~$600M (~3.3 years). EV ~$165M ≈ 0.9× sales — construction books, not regulated-asset marks. Cement & Building Materials is a captive supplier; Logistics moves plant and aggregates.

portfolio.name: DRC Cement & Building Materials
portfolio.location: Kinshasa / Bas-Congo, Democratic Republic of Congo
portfolio.notes: Integrated cement/aggregates (~0.85 Mtpa). Captive demand from hospital, data-center, telecom, and hospitality builds plus third-party DRC commercial sales. EBITDA ~20% is a normal cement mid-cycle margin (energy is the swing factor). EV ~$210M ≈ 3× revenue. River barge distribution from quarry/kiln complex.

portfolio.name: Kinshasa Water Treatment Works
portfolio.notes: 120 MLD treatment + distribution concession serving industrial parks, the University of Kinshasa campus (incl. on-campus hospital), and dense residential zones. Utility EV ~5.4× revenue with ~30% EBITDA — consistent with contracted water infrastructure. Improves reliability for Congo AI cooling and the university hospital campus; 25-year concession tenor.

portfolio.name: Mvita Cold Chain & Food Processing
portfolio.notes: Downstream of Agricultural Operations: cassava flour, palm refining, rice milling, export packaging + reefer logistics. Food processing EBITDA ~15% after raw-material COGS. Cuts post-harvest loss and captures margin beyond farmgate; uses dry port for containers and WtE residual heat where engineering allows.

entities.name: Don-Pierre Ventures
entities.notes: Venture / growth equity across fintech, infra-software, deep tech, and climate. Late-stage names near profitability; Series A/B and deep tech still burn at stage-realistic absolute dollars so PE cash flow can fund the book.

portfolio.name: Mvita Fintech Platform
portfolio.notes: Neobank + mobile money + remittance + merchant acquiring across UAE and DRC (~2.5M actives). Series D path to profitability (~6% EBITDA). Marked ~5.5× revenue. ARPU supports ~$150M run-rate. Rails into DRC Telecom and Congo AI credit/fraud models.

portfolio.name: Congo AI & Data Center
portfolio.notes: Colocation + GPU cloud + AI services (~12 MW IT). Series C ramp: still burning on power/GPU refresh, but burn narrowed as occupancy rises. Mark near invested capital + modest premium.

portfolio.name: Mvita Ionospheric Research Facility
portfolio.notes: HAARP-class phased HF array and atmospheric monitoring complex. Marked at replacement/construction cost (~$450M in 2026 USD) — not an income-producing EV. Pre-revenue; ~$14M annual run-rate during commissioning. Co-located with Congo AI for modeling and with Satellite & Downlink for RF/space-weather adjacency.

portfolio.name: Mvita Advanced Research & Patent Labs (MARPL)
portfolio.type: Advanced R&D / IP Holding / Technology Commercialization
portfolio.location: Toronto, Canada / Kinshasa, DRC / Dubai, UAE
portfolio.notes: Central R&D / IP holdco. Licensing revenue growing slowly; burn right-sized for multi-lab ops without dominating the VC book. Patent targets remain disciplined (~40 filings / year).

portfolio.name: Mvita HealthTech
portfolio.notes: Telemedicine and hospital workflow SaaS anchored on the University of Kinshasa on-campus teaching hospital. Series B healthtech typically still burns; ~6.7× revenue mark with path to profitability. Congo AI triage; DRC Telecom connectivity.

portfolio.name: Mvita AgriTech
portfolio.notes: Sensors, drones, irrigation control, and yield models — first deployed on Agricultural Operations (~28k ha instrumented) then sold regionally. Hardware-inclusive agtech burns cash at Series B; ~5.6× revenue mark.

portfolio.name: Mvita Fleet OS
portfolio.notes: Fleet management, EV charging orchestration, and predictive maintenance SaaS (~4,200 vehicles under management). Complements Mobility Fund without marking vehicle NAVs. First seats: Protective Services and Logistics. Series B SaaS ~5× revenue with light burn.

portfolio.name: Mvita Sovereign Cloud & Cyber
portfolio.notes: Sovereign cloud + managed SOC for governments/banks and portfolio critical sites. Approaching breakeven at Series C (~5.5× revenue). Protects Fintech, Congo AI, telecom core; consumes MARPL crypto/comms IP where licensed.

portfolio.name: Mvita Climate & Carbon MRV
portfolio.notes: MRV for WtE diversion, regenerative agri, and REDD-adjacent projects. Climate tech Series A: high burn, thin early revenue. Congo AI baselines; voluntary + Article 6 registry interfaces.

portfolio.name: Mvita Satellite & Downlink
portfolio.notes: Equatorial ground segment co-located with Ionospheric Facility and Congo AI. Mark near build cost during ramp; early antenna-time revenue only. Avoids infrastructure fantasy multiples on thin revenue.

portfolio.name: Mvita Robotics & Warehouse Automation
portfolio.notes: AMRs/sortation for Logistics dry port, Cold Chain, and Dubai industrial park (~320 robots deployed). Hardware+software Series B still burns. Congo AI for perception stacks; assembly in Dubai free zone.

entities.name: Don-Pierre Fund
entities.notes: Public markets vehicle. Focus on liquid dividend-paying assets, ETFs, and bonds.

portfolio.name: Infinity Fund — Main Strategy
portfolio.notes: Dedicated public markets vehicle for the Mvita Family Trust.

portfolio.name: Don-Pierre Treasury & Credit
portfolio.location: Dubai, UAE / Zurich, Switzerland / Toronto, Canada
portfolio.notes: Combined treasury management and private credit vehicle deploying idle family cash into low-risk interest-bearing instruments and internal lending. $350M deployed in short-term government/corporate bonds at 4.5% yield. $350M deployed in private credit to portfolio companies at 11% yield. Annual interest income of ~$54.25M with minimal operating expenses. Provides liquidity management for the Mvita Family Trust while generating yield on otherwise idle capital.
